selection_sources_allowed: The previously frozen calibration inputs and calibration-only trajectories
Public analytic error certificates and predeclared targets
selection_sources_forbidden: Original held-out extrema, logits, errors or token choices
Any output or domain observations from the new validation proposal

assumptions: No gate projection bias; fail if a bias tensor exists or configuration differs
Pinned exact binary32 public tensor values
Exact-real native operator algebra; finite-precision and CKKS errors are separate
public_gate_bound.outward_algorithm: Compute every weighted-square term and sum as exact dyadic Fractions; choose a binary64 sqrt endpoint whose exact rational square encloses the result. Multiply any explicitly certified rational norm-error factor and round the resulting Fraction outward.
public_gate_bound.report_inventory: All28 layers and3072 rows per layer; tensor hashes plus per-row bound and layer maximum; no model forward or activation reads.

approximate_norm_extension.condition: On a declared variance domain, a UNIFORM certificate |sqrt(v)*p(v)-1|<=delta and the SAME x,v relation yields |gate_j| <= (1+delta)*B_j.
approximate_norm_extension.candidate_domain_rule: Use symmetric per-layer [-max_j outward((1+delta)*B_j), +max_j outward((1+delta)*B_j)] unless a separately specified per-channel implementation is approved. Do not select a smaller domain from held-out extrema.
approximate_norm_extension.existing_newton_option: The candidate1 exact rounded-first-affine residual certificate can supply ideal-real uniform delta on its declared domain, excluding later finite-precision/CKKS errors.
approximate_norm_extension.existing_polynomial_option: For power or balanced-Chebyshev, certify the actual rounded public circuit polynomial over the entire variance interval, for example exact-rational residual polynomial 1-v*p(v)^2 plus Bernstein/interval subdivision; grid targets alone cannot supply delta.
unsolved_conditions: Calibration variance domains still need coverage; public gate bound does not certify inverse-sqrt input domains.
An independently perturbed encrypted variance can break the norm relation.
With output error e before the gate, add ||W_j||2*||e||2; gate linear arithmetic needs its own error term.
Native float32 and NumPy/HE execution errors are not automatically covered by the exact-real bound.
Bound magnitudes and feasible SiLU degree/rational depth are unknown until the public-weight pass and interval certificates; no implicit precision or refresh guarantee.

protocol_sequence: Root reviews this design and exact public-source implementation.
Verify pinned model/config/public tensor inventory; compute all outward public gate bounds without any model execution.

Verify the proposed fresh validation raw-text fixture and tokenizer-only uniqueness/disjointness against ALL earlier calibration and original validation token sequences, separately for each token length. Reject collisions before freezing final new inputs.

Freeze new calibration/selection protocol, analytic targets and maximum candidate budget before selection. No old held-out feedback is allowed to fit coefficients; this new design is explicitly motivated by its failure category.
Certify post-normalization multiplier errors or record unsupported sites; select a candidate only from public weights and calibration sources. Preserve all unsupported conditioning/depth failures.
Freeze candidate sources/coefficients/domains before approximate calibration; evaluate all288 prefills+64teacher+64free calibration contexts with unchanged gates.

Only after a complete successful frozen calibration and root review, open the fresh validation workload for model evaluation. Run48prefills+32teacher+32free with strict native same-prefix comparisons and stopped-suffix records.
Preserve original validation failure separately. New-set success is a new experiment and does not replace the original published workload results or claim encrypted execution.
